sourceReviewNotes: All 12 paper pages, 20 scheme pages and 32 generated source figures visually read. Eleven first-occurrence SymbolMT glyphs checked against the rendered source.
101 separately practicable tasks; 32/32 census leaves covered. Raw ask scan: 100 lines with one narrative When exemption retained in context.
All ten Q5 parts and both j options, both 56-mark Q10 alternatives, eight complete Tesla passage tasks, and all four Q12 alternatives retained.
All six Boyle data pairs, six steam measurements, four diffraction orders/angles, eight platinum-resistance data pairs and full bulb current–voltage graph retained.

Complete alternative apparatus and detector routes retain their individual tariffs. Any-N choices remain single cards. The diffraction-angle and historical-neutrino clarifications appear in the student-facing reveal.

Historical SEC beta equation retained exactly as printed, alongside a visible electron-antineutrino clarification. The original massless-neutrino wording has a visible modern correction. Scientific checks: https://www.energy.gov/science/doe-explainsbeta-decay and https://neutrinos.fnal.gov/mysteries/mass/.

The beta equation card initially failed the glyph guard because the explanatory note used a combining macron. Writing electron antineutrino in words preserves the correction and all 101 runtime cards; no guard was weakened.
All 2604 prior authored records, 1324 prior Higher runtime blocks, the complete Ordinary runtime file, 449 prior figures and 22 prior audit records remain unchanged.
